summary.text: TH. JOHANSEN & SØNNER AS is a private limited company registered in Hamar, founded 1984-08-29. TH. JOHANSEN & SØNNER AS is engaged in contracting (entreprenørvirksomhet) and other economic activity in this context. Its main industry code is 41.000: construction of residential and non-residential buildings. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 191 550 586 NOK and the annual result was 8 018 828 NOK; operating income was up from 175 672 966 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 10 742 501 NOK in 2024 to 8 018 828 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 14 409 524 NOK in 2024 to 18 058 852 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Sture Pedersen (daglig leder) and Pål Dobloug (styrets leder), with 1 other board member. The registered employee count went from 68 on 2025-11-13 to 70 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-01 (forretningsadresse/postnummer, forretningsadresse/poststed).
